An About card, the collector hidden until it has somewhere to send, and a button that shakes instead of leaving a sentence behind.

## ✨ Added

- **"Über diese Browsererweiterung"**, a card at the end of the options page carrying the versions, one sentence inviting a report, and two buttons: the repository, and a mail with the subject already filled in. The quiet centred version line under the last card is gone with it, because that line had nowhere to put the thing somebody reading a version number usually wants next. Now GlimStone 1.7.0 for the whole family.
- **The countdown field has its arrows back, drawn by us.** 1.12.1 dropped the operating system's spinner, which was right, and dropped the affordance with it, which was not. Two square steppers in the page's own tokens, driven by the field's own `stepUp`/`stepDown` so the range lives in one place, each greyed out at its own end.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The link collector was visible before there was anywhere to send to.** The code hiding it was correct the whole time; the stylesheet quietly refused. `#collector { display: flex }` outranks the browser's own `[hidden] { display: none }`, so the attribute was a comment. The same defect had the options page's own leave button on screen with no group to leave. One rule per page now, so `hidden` means hidden.
- **A refused connect shakes the button instead of leaving a sentence on the page.** That is GlimStone's standing rule for every failable action, and this page had only the half it objects to: unlike a transient, an inline sentence never clears itself, so a failure from ten minutes ago looks exactly as current as one from a second ago. The reason lives on the button's tooltip, one hover away.
- **The accent's reset badge is always there.** It used to appear only once the colour had moved, which is defensible and turned out to be wrong for the same reason the palette's own reset was already unconditional: people check whether a reset exists BEFORE deciding to experiment, not after.
- **The rows in the Colours card sat 28 apart instead of 12.** A flex gap and a child margin do not merge the way two vertical margins collapse. They add, and both were 14.
- **The diagnostic report names each content script and the redirect ruleset**, not just how many scripts are registered. Every way Click'n'Load can be dead, the switch off, nothing registered, a registration stale from before a fix, the ruleset not loaded, produces the same nothing on screen, and a count told those four apart not at all.
